{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check if site and severity are associated (already done, but reconfirm)
print("Cross-tabulation of site vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_dedup['site'], df_dedup['severity']))

# Compute response rate within each severity stratum for each site
response_stratified = df_dedup.groupby(['site', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nResponse rate by site and severity (within strata):")
print(response_stratified)

# Compute overall severity distribution (to use as weights)
severity_dist = df_dedup['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print("\nOverall severity distribution:")
print(severity_dist)

# Compute weighted average response rate by site
weighted_response_rate = response_stratified.multiply(severity_dist, axis=1).sum(axis=1) * 100
print("\nWeighted average response rate by site (adjusted for severity):")
print(weighted_response_rate)

# Find which site has the highest weighted response rate
best_site = weighted_response_rate.idxmax()
best_rate = weighted_response_rate.max()
print(f"\nSite with highest weighted response rate: {best_site} ({best_rate:.2f}%)")"}
